description: This file defines the SimpleGeofence class, which models a geofence with properties such as ID, location, radius, expiration, and transition type. It provides methods to access these properties and to create a Geofence object compatible with Location Services from its data.

classes.name: SimpleGeofence
classes.description: A class representing a geofence with location, radius, expiration, and transition details, and a method to convert this information into a Geofence object for location services.

methods.name: SimpleGeofence
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the geofence with ID, latitude, longitude, radius, expiration, and transition type.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the request ID of the geofence.

methods.name: getLatitude
methods.description: Returns the latitude of the geofence's center.

methods.name: getLongitude
methods.description: Returns the longitude of the geofence's center.

methods.name: getRadius
methods.description: Returns the radius of the geofence.

methods.name: getExpirationDuration
methods.description: Returns the expiration duration of the geofence.

methods.name: getTransitionType
methods.description: Returns the transition type of the geofence.

methods.name: toGeofence
methods.description: Creates and returns a Geofence object based on the SimpleGeofence's properties.
